programme.desc: Adele, Panda and the rest set a trap to lure Onizuka Hideo out, but to no avail.

programme.title: The Driver
programme.desc: Onizuka Hideo wants Ke Qiang to find out the whereabouts of "The Vigilante".

programme.title: Shero
programme.desc: Yinxi escorts socialite Gina to Australia for an auction, Yinchen tags along. Gina sells her necklace at a high price to Mr and Mrs Yue Feihong.

programme.title: Shero
programme.desc: Unable to find Yinxi, Yinchen makes a police report. Ruixiang notices that someone is tailing him and injures himself accidentally. At the hospital, Ruixiang runs into Yinchen, who is still trying to look for Yinxi.

programme.title: Faculty
programme.desc: It's the day of Sylvia's disciplinary hearing; she braces herself to come clean with the board.

programme.title: Faculty
programme.desc: It's the start of Malcolm's fall and the rise of Madelyn as news of his plagiarism breaks.

programme.title: Faculty
programme.desc: A new normal seems to have settled at Straits University, with Madelyn being acting dean.

programme.title: Silo
programme.desc: The silo explodes and Mother is injured. The siblings decide if they should venture into the world.

programme.title: Silo
programme.desc: They investigate what the mysterious word "allies" inscribed on Faye's body means.

programme.title: Pixies Electric: Club Date live in Boston
programme.desc: Legendary alternative rock band The Pixies perform their greatest hits including 'Alison', 'Bone Machine', 'Bad Punk' and classic 'Where is My Mind' in an intimate setting in Boston.

programme.title: Evanescence - Synthesis Live
programme.desc: In 2003, Evanescence released Fallen, one of the most decade-defining albums (and one of the most successful debut albums of all time) and have gone on to became one of the most well-loved & respected bands of their generation.

programme.title: ZZ Top - Live at Montreux
programme.desc: ZZ Top has made a number of visits to Montreux and this concert from 2013 is undoubtedly one of their finest live performances. The set list blends tracks from early seventies through their eighties blockbuster period and up to their most recent release. Music video by ZZ Top __© 2013 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: Willie Nelson - Live at iTunes Festival
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Eric Clapton & Steve Winwood - Live from Madison Square Garden
programme.desc: History rocked and rock made history during a sold-out 3-gig stand at Madison Square Garden in February 2008 when Eric Clapton and Steve Winwood performed a concert together for the first time since their days in the legendary Blind Faith in 1969.

programme.title: Qello Concerts' Best
programme.desc: The best of Qello Concerts.

programme.title: Charli XCX - Reading & Leeds Festival 2022
programme.desc: The Reading and Leeds Festivals are a pair of music festivals that take place annually in the cities of Reading and Leeds in England. Featuring Charli XCX.

programme.title: John Legend - Live at the iTunes Festival
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007. Featuring: John Legend.

programme.title: Imagine Dragons - Live At The Moody Theater
programme.desc: Filmed at The Moody Theater, Texas, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Imagine Dragons featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Demons', 'Radioactive' and many more.

programme.title: Usher - Omg Tour (Live from London)
programme.desc: Treating the crowd at London's O2 Arena to his signature brand of R&B infused pop, Usher performed hits from recent albums Versus and Raymond V. Raymond, including DJ Got Us Falling in Love, There Goes My Baby, and OMG.

programme.title: One Direction: Apple Music Festival
programme.desc: One Direction performs a stellar set at the 2015 edition of the Apple Music Festival. Be prepared to sing along to their catchy chart-topping hits!

programme.title: Lana Del Rey - Live in London 2012
programme.desc: Born to Die is the second album by singer-songwriter Lana Del Rey, and the first to be officially released on January 27, 2012 and that would lead to global success; In countries such as the United Kingdom the album was the best selling of that year.

programme.title: Jimi Hendrix - Band of Gypsys Documentary
programme.desc: This Grammy-winning documentary features the only known concert footage of Band of Gypsys, offering crucial insight into Jimi Hendrix's music. It includes interviews with bandmates and rock legends like Lenny Kravitz and Slash.

programme.title: The Lumineers - Live At Musilac 2017
programme.desc: The Lumineers bring energetic American folk-rock to the picturesque Musilac Festival. You won't be able to resist clapping along and stomping your feet to the band's raw sound and enchanting music.

programme.title: Bruce Springsteen: Live in Hyde Park
programme.desc: "London Calling: Live in Hyde Park" is a concert video of Bruce Springsteen & the E Street Band's performance during the Hard Rock Calling music festival in Hyde Park, London on June 28, 2009.

programme.title: Alanis Morissette - Live at Montreux 2012
programme.desc: On 2 July 2012 Alanis Morissette returned to Montreux as part of her Guardian Angel Tour. The set showcased a number of tracks from the new album alongside classic tracks from across her career. Music video by Alanis Morissette © 2012 Montreux Sounds (/RTS), under exclusive license to Eagle Rock Entertainment Ltd.

programme.title: Coldplay - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Def Leppard - Hysteria At The O2
programme.desc: Sheffield's finest make their long-awaited debut at London's O2m Arena in November 2018. Marking the 31st anniversary of Hysteria they played the whole of the ground breaking album in chronological order featuring hits like Pour Some Sugar on Me, Animal, Women and the title track.

programme.title: AC/DC - Circus Krone
programme.desc: Filmed at the Circus Krone in Munich, this concert features performances of "Rock N Roll Damnation" and "What's Next to the Moon" and more.

programme.title: David Gilmour - Remember That Night
programme.desc: David Gilmour - Remember That Night: Live at the Royal Albert Hall is recorded by guitarist David Gilmour where he presents live tracks from the album On an Island and some hits from his former band Pink Floyd.

programme.title: Foo Fighters - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: The Black Keys: Live at Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Black Keys, an American rock duo, perform their top tracks at the Austin City Limits Music Festival.

programme.title: Lenny Kravitz - Live at the iTunes Festival
programme.desc: Lenny Kravitz has been consolidated as one of the stars that has been in force for a long time, this has led him to appear all over the world and be part of the most popular festivals in the world.

programme.title: James Morrison - T In The Park
programme.desc: T in the Park festival is a major Scottish music festival that has been held almost annually since 1994 (the event did not take place in 2017). It is named after its main sponsor, the brewing company Tennent's.

programme.title: Florence + the Machine -- Live at Apple Music Festival
programme.desc: Following a week of class acts, Florence Welch celebrated both the final night of 2015's Apple Music Festival and her father's birthday with a flawless performance at London's Roundhouse.

programme.title: Jack White - Live at iTunes Festival
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: The Moody Blues - Days of Future Passed Live
programme.desc: This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance the album Days of Future Passed.

programme.title: James Taylor - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas; the festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Heart - Live At The Royal Albert Hall
programme.desc: This film captures not only Heart's first-ever live performance at the Royal Albert Hall but is also the first concert film of Heart performing with a full orchestra.

programme.title: Lynyrd Skynyrd: Pronounced Leh-Nerd Skin-Nerd & Second Helping - Live From The Florida Theater
programme.desc: Earlier this year Lynyrd Skynyrd performed their first two studio albums, Pronounced 'Lĕh-'nérd 'Skin-'nérd and Second Helping, live in their entirety for the first time, at two specially staged concerts at the Florida Theatre in their home town of Jacksonville, Florida.

programme.title: Rush - Time Machine: Live in Cleveland
programme.desc: Celebrating 30 years since the 1981 release of their classic bestselling album 'Moving Pictures,' the band performed the entire album live for the first time as the centerpiece of the concerts.

programme.title: Rich Girl’s First Day at a Poor School: Poor, Rich and Giga Rich Students!
programme.desc: When a rich girl steps into a poor school for the first time, her glamorous lifestyle shocks everyone! From luxury gadgets to creative DIY crafts, watch how rich, poor, and giga-rich students face hilarious challenges and surprising twists. Who will win the ultimate school showdown? Find out in this fun and entertaining story full of secrets, style, and school drama!

programme.title: Art Supplies: Rich and Poor! The Ultimate Creative Showdown
programme.desc: What happens when luxury meets resourcefulness in an art battle? We're pitting the most expensive, high-end art supplies against clever, everyday cheap crafts! Watch the ultimate creative showdown as we try to make masterpieces from two completely different worlds. Will the pricey professional tools win, or will the ingenious budget-friendly hacks take the crown? Prepare for stunning results, shocking surprises, and a whole lot of creative fun

programme.title: If Food Were People! The Ultimate Cooking Showdown
programme.desc: What if your food had a personality? In our craziest challenge yet, we're bringing meals to life! Watch the ultimate cooking showdown between Me, my Grandma, and a Professional Chef. But there's a twist! Every dish we create has a wild, personified story. Who will create the most hilarious food character? Get ready for epic recipes, crazy characters, and a battle of creativity you won't forget!

programme.title: Geometric Food: No Hands, One Hand and Two Hands Cooking Showdown
programme.desc: It’s time for a crazy food challenge! Watch as we tackle the Geometric Food Challenge, creating perfectly shaped dishes, and then dive into a wild cooking battle: No Hands vs One Hand vs Two Hands! Who will cook the best meal with the least amount of hands? And which geometric creations will taste the best? It's a hilarious and tasty adventure of skill, creativity, and chaos!

programme.title: Giant, Medium or Tiny Food? Gold and Silver Color Showdown!
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate food challenge! We’re creating Giant, Medium and Tiny versions of your favorite foods while battling it out with dazzling gold and silver ingredients! From massive burgers to shimmering silver pizzas, it’s a fun, epic showdown of size and color. Who will win the tastiest, most creative creation? Watch to find out!

programme.title: Ultimate Food Challenge! Bite, Lick, Nothing and One-Color ASMR
programme.desc: Get ready for the most sensory and suspenseful food challenge yet! We're combining two epic games into one. First, the tense "Bite, Lick, or Nothing" challenge will have us on the edge of our seats! Then, we dive into a mesmerizing One-Color Food ASMR battle—will it be a vibrant green feast or a pretty in pink paradise?

programme.title: Extreme Eating Challenges! No Hands and Plate Size Showdown
programme.desc: Get ready for the most hilarious and messy eating challenges ever! We're putting our skills to the test in two crazy battles. First, can we even eat with no hands? Then, we're messing with our minds in a Big Plate and Small Plate illusion challenge! It's a full-on showdown of strategy, silliness, and serious spills. Who will master the one-hand technique? Who will be fooled by the plate size? Watch to find out and get ready to laugh!

programme.title: 3D Pen and Pancake Art Challenge! Best Art Wins $1,000!
programme.desc: Get ready for the ultimate art showdown! Watch as we go head-to-head in a 3D Pen vs Pancake Art Challenge, where creativity meets deliciousness! Who will create the most mind-blowing masterpiece to win a $1,000 prize? Plus, stick around for some amazing TikTok hacks, viral art tips, and parenting secrets to level up your life!

programme.title: Secret Candy Missions! How to Sneak Candy Everywhere
programme.desc: Got a sweet tooth but stuck in class? We've got you covered!This is your ultimate guide to becoming a candy ninja! Discover the most brilliant and sneaky life hacks to sneak your favorite treats anywhere—especially into school. Learn clever hiding spots, genius disguises, and pro-level strategies to enjoy your candy without getting caught. Master the art of the sweet sneak! Just don't blame us if you get caught...

programme.title: 24 Hours Eating Only One Color Food! Pink World, Bubble Gum Battle and Last-to-stop Color Challenge
programme.desc: Who will survive the longest? Who picks the tastiest meals? And who totally fails? Grab a snack (maybe in YOUR favorite color!) and enjoy the fun!

programme.title: Poor and Rich Art Challenge! Who Is Better? Cool Drawing Hacks And Diy Ideas
programme.desc: Ready for the ultimate creativity showdown? In this video, we're diving into the world of Rich vs. Broke challenges! We'll show you amazing art hacks using expensive supplies versus super cool tricks you can do with everyday stuff you have at home.

programme.title: Crazy Food Challenges! One-color Meal and No-hands Eating!
programme.desc: Get ready for the most hilarious and messy food challenges ever! In this video, we're taking on two epic food battles that will have you laughing out loud!

programme.title: Popular Barbie or Dark Barbie? Rich and Poor Doll Makeover
programme.desc: Welcome to the ultimate Barbie makeover and school craft showdown! In this fun mash-up, we’re blending Popular Barbie vs Dark Barbie school crafts with the dramatic and creative transformations of Rich vs Poor Barbie dolls!

programme.title: Brilliant Polymer Clay, Nanotape and Cardboard Crafts! Easy DIY Ideas
programme.desc: Get ready to unleash your creativity with the best polymer clay, nanotape, and cardboard crafts! Whether you’re looking for fun DIY projects, cool room decorations, or clever handmade gifts, this video has it all.

programme.title: High School You and Child You! Types Of Students, School Hacks and Funny Relatable Moments
programme.desc: Get ready for the funniest school mash-up ever! In this mega-compilation, we’re diving into High School You or Child You, exploring all the Types of Students in Class, and testing out some unbelievable DIY school hacks every parent and student will love!

programme.title: Amazing 3D Pen Hacks and DIY Jewelry Mini Decor
programme.desc: Do you like 3D pen and hot glue crafts? This video is exactly for you then! Here you can find a lot of fantastic 3D pen and hot glue ideas, DIY hacks and artistic crafts.

programme.title: 11 REBELS [English Dub]
programme.desc: Amidst the Boshin War's brutal conflicts, a motley squad of criminals and samurai undertakes a desperate defense of a fortress, their stand triggered by clashing interests of the Shibata clan, the shogunate, and the new government.

programme.title: THE WITCH 2: THE OTHER ONE [English Dub]
programme.desc: After escaping from a secluded laboratory, a young girl with overwhelming power finds herself on the run from several mysterious organizations, seeking refuge with a woman and her younger brother.

programme.title: Spiritwalker [English Dub]
programme.desc: With amnesia, a man shifts bodies every 12 hours, racing against time to regain memories and evade unknown threats.

programme.title: Rampant [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Returning from imprisonment, a prince and his fellow countrymen band together to battle bloodthirsty demons.

programme.title: The Unrighteous [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A realistic horror film about a young man trying to protect his family from his neighbors after illegal flyers are distributed in an old villa in the suburbs, leading to a sense of unease.

programme.title: The Isle [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: There is a fishing resort remote from the world. The owner, Hee-jin, drops by floating houses and serves the customers: by selling them food, necessities, and sex. One day, a new customer arrives: Hyun-suk is a former detective who killed his cheating girlfriend. Hee-jin feels a bond with him and keeps watching him. That night, he tries to shoot himself, but she stops him. As some incidents happen, she develops an obsession with him. And he also finds it difficult to leave the fishing resort and her.

programme.title: Beasts Clawing at Straws [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A large bag of money appears in front of Tae-young, Jung-man, and Yeon-hee. Unexpected events occur to them chasing the bag of money, believing it to be the last chance.

programme.title: Seobok: Project Clone [English Dub]
programme.desc: Ex-agent guards the first human clone against enemies, facing a dire decision.

programme.title: SWORD MASTER [English Dub]
programme.desc: Sword Master is a martial arts action story about an elite swordsman who fakes his death to escape violence, only to be dragged back by his past. Starring Lin Gengxin, Peter Ho, Jiang Yiyan. Exhausted by endless bloodshed, a legendary master fakes his death to live in anonymity.

programme.title: High Forces [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Distanced from his family after a car accident takes the sight of his daughter, a father must use his professional bodyguard training when a flight they're on is overtaken by armed hijackers. A taut puzzle of deception unravels when the hijackers' motivations are revealed and the father must rescue not only his daughter and wife, but all those aboard.

programme.title: My Daughter is a Zombie [English Dub]
programme.desc: Lee Jeong-hwan, a fierce animal trainer, lives a chaotic daily life with his rebellious teenage daughter, Lee Su-a who is full of passion for dancing. One day, Su-a becomes infected by a zombie virus that has swept across the globe. In a desperate bid to protect her, Jeong-hwan takes Su-a to Eunbong-ri, a seaside village where his mother, Kim Bam-sun, lives. Amid growing societal pressure to root out the infected, Jeong-hwan notices that Su-a, despite being a zombie, vaguely understands human speech and reacts to her favorite things: dancing and her grandmother’s sharp but loving flicks of the hand. Refusing to give up on her, Jeong-hwan draws on his years of experience as a tiger trainer and begins an intensive training program for his zombie daughter. A training journey more terrifying than handling a tiger and more difficult than dealing with teenage angst begins. The most heartwarming and hilarious top-secret project is about to unfold!

programme.title: IP MAN 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Having defeated the best fighters of the Imperial Japanese army in occupied Shanghai, Ip Man and his family settle in post-war Hong Kong. Struggling to make a living, Master Ip opens a kung fu school to bring his celebrated art of Wing Chun to the troubled youth of Hong Kong. His growing reputation soon brings challenges from powerful enemies, including pre-eminent Hung Gar master, Hung Quan.

programme.title: IP MAN 3 [English Dub]
programme.desc: When a band of brutal gangsters led by a crooked property developer make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.

programme.title: BADGES OF FURY [English Dub]
programme.desc: In just 3 days, three cases of Smiling Murder shock Hong Kong. The young detective Wang Bu'er and his buddy Huang Feihong embark on an investigation full of excitement and unexpected events.

programme.title: Ghost Blows The Lamp of the Longling Temple [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shirley Yang returns to China in search of professor Sun to rid herself of her erythema, only to find him trapped in the mysterious Long Ling cave.

programme.title: Emergency Declaration [English Dub]
programme.desc: After a terror incident occurs mid-flight, a passenger jet declares an emergency.

programme.title: DETECTIVE K: SECRET OF THE LIVING DEAD [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: When a series of unusual murders occurs, Detective K (KIM Myung-min) and his partner (OH Dal-soo) are once again called into action as they discover a trail of bodies with mysterious bite marks.

programme.title: KUNG FU KILLER [English Dub]
programme.desc: A martial arts instructor from the police force gets imprisoned after killing a man by accident. But when a vicious killer starts targeting martial arts masters, the instructor offers to help the police in return for his freedom.

programme.title: Memoir of a Murderer [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A former serial killer Byung-su gets diagnosed with Alzheimer’s. When a series of murders occur near his town, Byung-su gets worried whether the killings are his doings during his memory lapses. But then, he comes across Tae-ju and instinctively realizes that he's the serial killer. He reports this to the police, only to learn that Tae-ju is one. With his memory slipping, Byung-su must find a way to protect his daughter from Tae-ju.

programme.title: Kill Zone 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: A Hong Kong cop named Kit busts a major gangster only to find his cover blown and his main witness gone. The gangster, in retaliation, has him kidnapped and put in a Thai jail with a false criminal identity. Lowly prison guard Chai, with his extraordinary fighting skills, guards Kit and prevents his escape. The prison guard’s daughter suffers from a rare form of leukemia and Kit is the only donor who can save her. The prison guard discovers Kit’s real identity and helps him to escape in return for his agreeing to save his daughter. Together, Kit and Chai must face and take down the gangster and his minions.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia jura venganza contra Ricardo tras ser plantada. Él se refugia con la Nona, sintiéndose solo por dejar a Celia por conciencia. Hortensia, influenciada por Benjamín, planea sacar a Ricardo de las empresas, mientras Malaver busca apoderarse de todo. Brigitte causa caos con un cuchillo antes de ser llevada por Misael. Celia confronta a los Tariffi en un arranque de furia, reafirmando su amor antes de desmayarse. Ricardo enfrenta a Malaver, quien exige su fortuna y a Hortensia.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Luis Fernando llega a su casa y María Gracia le da la sorpresa de que Dileidy lo fue a buscar a su casa y Aureliano le dice a Dileidy lo mismo. María Gracia está por irse de modelo a Japón y antes de irse, le dice a Luis Fernando que busque a Dileidy.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Matilde se sincera con Pascua y le dice que Moncho y ella ya no están juntos, pero Pascua no se lo toma a bien y sabe que ella sabía que eso pasaría. Debido a la burla de Gonzalo, toda la oficina se entera que Matilde y Moncho no están más juntos.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Pascua le dice a Edén que se siente muy mal porque Matilde fue la que dejó a Moncho y no al revés, después llegan sus hijas con buenas noticias. Santiago lleva helado a Matilde para animarla, pero Ernesto no se lo toma a bien y hace malos comentarios.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Gladis y Marco Aurelio acuerdan que será mejor vivir separados porque cada uno extraña su soledad, pero podrán verse cada que quieran. Después, él le da la noticia a Yesenia y ella se muestra feliz al saber que Gladis se mudará de ahí.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.desc: Eden llega a casa de Pascua para hablar con ella, pero se lleva una gran sorpresa al verla llegar muy contenta con Moncho tomados de la mano. Rómulo está en el aeropuerto para irse al Orinoco, pero dentro de él espera que Egleé impida que se vaya.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro trata de acercarse a Sol y tener contacto amoroso, pero ella se resiste, dando por sentado que son hermanos. Es por esto que le pide a Aída que vuelva a vivir a la casa, para acercarse a Alejandro y ganar su amor. Aída sabe que esto no es cierto, sin embargo, Heriberto la llama, ya que si ella se queda con Alejandro, Sol buscará consuelo en él, entonces la amenaza, y si ella no cumple con eso, él buscará la manera de herir a Alejandro o a los niños.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Reina le confirma a Alicia que ni ella ni Alejandro son hijos de Eloy. Alejandro al enterarse de que Alicia no es hija de Eloy le pide al médico que le confirme si es hermano de Sol. Este le dice que se lo dirá al otro día. Alejandro va con la noticia a Sol pero esta no quiere hacerse falsas ilusiones. Maricielo está a punto de confirmar que Alicia mandó a matar a Rómulo. Heriberto le pide a Anselmo que lo deje salir de la cárcel por una noche para tener intimidad con Sol.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol le dice a Heriberto que si ella resulta ser hermana de Alejandro, se entregará a él, por lo que Madroño planifica un escape de la prisión y logra que Anselmo Rodríguez lo ayude. Así es que visita a Sol. Giselle y Bárbara se ponen furiosas cuando se enteran de que Maricielo le ha ofrecido hospedaje a Miyogla en su misma casa, por lo que el miedo de perder a Cristo José crece en ambas. Rika, muy dolida y enojada, le confiesa a Sergio que ha descubierto su ex mujer está embarazada.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Heriberto tiene extorsionado a Anselmo, y lo usa para salir de la cárcel. Cuando ambos van a la casa de Sol, ella le dice la verdad a Heriberto sobre sus sentimientos y le confiesa que la única manera de que terminen juntos es que Alejandro sea su hermano. Reina se encuentra en la prisión con Alicia, que va para pedirle a su madre que la ayude a sacar del medio a Maricielo. A cambio de ese favor Alicia ha alterado los resultados de la prueba de ADN de Sol y Alejandro.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Anselmo ayuda a Heriberto a escapar de la cárcel. Heriberto visita por sorpresa a Sol en su mansión, dispuesto en llevarla a la cama. Sol da muchas vueltas con el asunto, y a pesar que le incomoda dormir con él, está segura que él es impotente y que no podrá hacerle nada. Alejandro la ve antes que se acueste, y ella le cuenta que irá a dormir con Madroño. Alejandro no puede tolerarlo, especialmente cuando el doctor Hernández lo ha llamado para citarlo y comentarle algo sobre el cotejo genético.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri se muestra perturbada ante la irrupción de Wilker en sus pensamientos ante el reproche de Yubiri Juan Diego se decide a acomodar lo acontecido con su frustrado compromiso para su beneficio al recordarle a Yubiri que cayo preso debido a su estadía en el barrio | Yubiri se deja halagar por la justificación de Juan Diego al retomar nuevamente su idea de haber sido la causa que permitió que el muchacho no se comprometiese | Juan Diego se aprovecha de la situación.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En la oficina de producción cinematográfica Graciela recibe la llegada de Gisela quien se muestra interesada en encontrarse con el Junior para comentar el guión de la película | Graciela escudriña en sus recuerdos al intentar memorizar la cara de Gisela al esta parecerle conocida con anterioridad | Gisela por su parte se confiesa abiertamente ante Graciela al tener la misma sensación de haber conocido a la muchacha con anterioridad | Junior interrumpe la conversación entre ambas mujeres.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En la oficina de Atanasio Briggite se llena de encanto para intentar explicarle a su jefe lo halagada que se siente al creerse convertida en su amante por falsos sucesos que solo ella alberga en su suposición | Atanasio guarda silencio mientras Briggite realiza el relato de la supuesta y apasionada noche que pasaron juntos | a pesar de su idea principal de intentar resolver la problemática existente en la frágil relación entre Carolina y su hijo Atanasio corrobora la versión de Briggite.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri se presta a consolar a Solimar al saberla herida por causa de la ruptura de su relación amorosa con Wilker | Solimar sintiéndose devastada por la decisión de su antiguo novio se confiesa ante Yubiri al hacerla participe del gran amor que albergaba por el muchacho a pesar de su platónica relación | Yubiri se deja atemorizar por la idea de haber sido el motivo de la decisión asumida por Wilker de terminar su noviazgo con Solimar | entre tanto su amiga le lanza una advertencia.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Botero eleva su protesta al sentirse víctima de la injusta decisión de Finita al creer a su esposa sin motivos para hacerlo pasar por la penuria de un divorcio. La familia Gamboa hace un recuento de su agotador día al haber colaborado cada uno con su aporte para hacer lucir su casa con un alegre ambiente navideño | ROKUro y Segundo se retiran de la sala al presentir la extensa conversación que advierten las mujeres de la familia al sentirse afectadas por causa del despecho asumido por Solimar.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Rebecca se enfrenta a Agustina cuando esta la descubre con Edgar y le ofrece dinero, a Leonardo y a sus hijos a cambio de su silencio. Leonardo regaña a Julio por lo que hizo. Él le dice que se siente excluido de la familia y para remediarlo, Leonardo le ofrece trabajar en la empresa, siempre y cuando se disculpe con su hermano y le cuente la verdad a María Lucía. Virginia va a visitar a Carlos Ernesto y se reconcilian. Él le pide que vuelva a ser su secretaria. Jimena se reúne con Adolfo y le dice que no se casará con él, porque la prioridad son sus hijos. Jimena, después de la reunión con Adolfo, va a casa de Carlos Ernesto y le comunica su decisión, pero con la condición de que él vaya a la clínica a rehabilitarse.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Irene está dispuesta a comenzar una relación con Felipe aunque sus sentimientos le siguen perteneciendo a Leonardo. Rebeca puso los papeles de identidad de forma legal y vuelven a ser un matrimonio con Leonardo ante la ley, tramando un nuevo plan para que Leonardo firme un nuevo acta de matrimonio sin cláusula de separación de bienes que en actual tienen. Carlos Ernesto junto a sus abogados han encontrado pruebas forjadas sobre la culpabilidad de Virginia del caso de Miguel Ferrándiz, y Adolfo está preocupado porque se reabra el caso.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo logra convencer a Irene de que lo acompañe a la empresa para poder resolver el problema con los documentos. Cuando llegan se encuentran con Alejandra, quien la culpa a Irene por todo el problema de papeleo que están teniendo. Irene intenta buscar por todas partes y llega a la conclusión de que alguien alteró la ubicación de esos archivos, por lo que, luego de recibir una segunda intimidación de Alejandra decide irse con Felipe, el cual no había podido tranquilizar a Mateo en la casa y decidió llevarlo hasta la empresa con la madre. Rodrigo se entera que están haciendo una reunión sin él y decide ir a participar de la misma por más que es solo para personal de confianza de la empresa.

programme.title: Serafima la bella

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Pyotr y Ksenia se aman desde hace años y sueñan con formar una familia justo cuando terminan sus estudios. Pero el padre de Ksenia, dueño de una constructora, es acusado de lavado de dinero a gran escala y podría perderlo todo, incluida su libertad. Entonces aparece Grigory Dmitrievich, un viejo conocido de la familia con poder en la administración local, dispuesto a salvarlo... a cambio de una sola condición: que Ksenia se case con su hijo Dima, un joven que estudia pintura.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Veinte años después, la familia del artista Dmitri llega a una ciudad costera de vacaciones con Ksenia y su hija Rita. Al recibir una invitación a la reunión escolar, Ksenia no puede negarse: en el fondo, muere por ver de nuevo a Piotr. Pero es Rita, de 19, quien se cruza primero con él, rescatada por Piotr de un peligro. Ahora periodista y editor respetado, con una historia explosiva sobre corrupción en antiguas propiedades del partido, Piotr empieza a sentir atracción por la joven.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Ksenia le exige a Piotr que se aleje de Rita, pero él no piensa repetir el error de dejar ir a su gran amor: está decidido a luchar por ella. Rita responde igual de firme: no renunciará a Piotr por sus padres. Mientras crece el escándalo de las casas estatales, Edik, colega de Piotr, descubre que intervienen su teléfono, vinculado a la élite política. La amenaza se vuelve real cuando dos desconocidos irrumpen en la redacción exigiendo el expediente, o la familia de Piotr pagará el precio.

programme.title: Ángel
programme.desc: Por seguridad, Pyotr decide que Rita debe quedarse con sus padres, y logra una tregua temporal con Ksenia. Pero cuando entrega su artículo para la próxima edición, órdenes "desde arriba" retiran toda la tirada acusándolo de difamación. Dmitri, sin renunciar a separar a la pareja, se reúne con Aleksandr, el exnovio de Rita e instructor del centro náutico, y le da su bendición para reconquistarla... con una condición: deshacerse de Pyotr.
